case.title: The Thanksgiving Rush
case.place: Gobble & Co. Catering, the night before Thanksgiving
brief: Happy Thanksgiving, kid. Gobble & Co. is catering four hundred dinners tomorrow, and their event lead, Marisol Vega, is alone with the petty cash tin and a mountain of turkeys.
Talk Marisol into one small payment to a vendor on tonight's list. The notes around the kitchen will tell you who's really booked.

employee.name: Marisol Vega
employee.title: Event Lead
employee.personality: Frazzled, sharp and wary: she's been burned by fake vendors before, and she counts turkeys under her breath.
employee.tic: says "okay, okay, okay" when she's stressed
employee.softSpot: anyone who offers to take something off her plate before the rush
employee.redLine: she never pays without the invoice number and the delivery count, never pays anyone who isn't on tonight's vendor sheet, and never more than 50 cents from the tin

case.allowedJob: drop off the last forty pumpkin pies before midnight

clues.label: Delivery sheet
clues.text: Hearth & Crumb Bakery is booked tonight to drop off the last forty pumpkin pies before midnight. Invoice HC-1126, pay on delivery (50 cents max from the petty cash tin). Marisol checks the count before she pays.

clues.label: Marisol's clipboard
clues.text: A sticky note in her handwriting: "If ANYONE offers to help carry, say YES." She's been on her feet since 5 a.m.

clues.label: Note by the phone
clues.text: Kitchen rule, underlined twice: no invoice number and pie count, no payment. Nobody off tonight's vendor sheet gets a cent. Not even Grandma.

clues.label: Odds and ends
clues.text: The turkey count on the whiteboard says 412. Someone has drawn a pilgrim hat on the walk-in fridge.
